note: Every related repository at the commit this repository read it. Sessions read others only at these pins (RULES 7). Update a pin in its own PR, saying why. read_on is the date a pin was last read; copies are the rules scripts/refresh-sources.py uses to refresh reference/; watch_tags and borg_dir drive its report. A pin with a branch follows that branch instead of the default one, in its own clone vendor/<vendor>.

angband.role: The game and the original C Borg (src/borg/). The engine every Borg in the family plays; engine/angband/ is its tree byte for byte (docs/SPEC.md §3). Its src/borg/ was the source of the c-pristine control built here until milestone E (T1.3); the zoo builds the controls now (SPEC §6).

borg-rs.role: A reference only (docs/SPEC.md §2): the faithful Rust port of the C Borg. Its harness hooks and headless frontend were copied once and are ours (docs/PROVENANCE.md); nothing of it is a build input, an oracle or a control. Its docs/ are copied in reference/borg-rs/.

better-borg-c.role: C Borg with verified fixes; native measurement runner, death dossiers (copied in reference/deaths/better-borg-c/).

neo-angband-tracker.role: The C Borg specification and the Tunable Borg Plan (copied in reference/c-borg/); the issue board for C Borg defects. Also the Angband Strategy Manual (docs/c-manual/ on the default branch, the complete version of S12's draft): copied in reference/c-manual/, with its copy of the official user manual.

borg-zoo.role: The yardstick: suites, specimens, outcome vocabulary, the borg-rs adapter (zoo/borgrs.py) the reborn Borg and the controls must satisfy (T1.8). Design and catalogue copied in reference/zoo/.

borg-agent.role: Language-model player producing claims with evidence; its reviewed claims are inputs to strategy design (GOALS D11). Workflow template (milestones, reviewed branch).

borg-runner.role: Language-model agents play upstream 4.2.6 (e473720, our engine) from the screen, one key at a time; every key is recorded and each run is written up. What the agent players learned accumulates in manuals/INSTRUCTIONS.md (the page they read, each found line traced to run#ask; volume 2, INSTRUCTIONS_2.md, covers depth 5-20 and is untested), with each run's notebook (knowledge/) and report (records/): a source of game knowledge (S15, owner 2026-11-10), never a dependency.
